sloka: क्रुद्धः पापं न कुर्यात् कः क्रुद्धो हन्याद् गुरूनपि ।क्रुद्धः परुषया वाचा नरः साधूनधिक्षिपेत् ।। 5.55.5 ।।।।
transliteration: kruddhaḥ pāpaṁ na kuryāt kaḥ kruddho hanyād gurūnapi ।kruddhaḥ paruṣayā vācā naraḥ sādhūnadhikṣipet ।। 5.55.5 ।।।।

translations.english: 'An angry person knows not what he should utter and what he should not. No act appears wrong for an angry man. Nothing is unutterable for him at any time, anywhere.
